final: WITH member_major_join AS (SELECT m.link_to_major, ma.department, COUNT(*) as group_count FROM member m JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id WHERE m.link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.link_to_major, ma.department), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) as total FROM member_major_join), group_shares AS (SELECT mmj.link_to_major, mmj.department, mmj.group_count, CAST(mmj.group_count AS REAL) / tc.total as group_share FROM member_major_join mmj CROSS JOIN total_count tc WHERE tc.total IS NOT NULL), dept_averages AS (SELECT department, AVG(group_share) as dept_avg FROM group_shares GROUP BY department), filtered_groups AS (SELECT gs.link_to_major, gs.department, gs.group_count, gs.group_share, gs.group_share - da.dept_avg as share_diff FROM group_shares gs JOIN dept_averages da ON gs.department = da.department WHERE gs.group_share > da.dept_avg) SELECT link_to_major, department, group_count, group_share, share_diff FROM filtered_groups ORDER BY CASE WHEN share_diff IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, share_diff DESC LIMIT 10
